info.title: BGP_Neighbor
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

prefix-list.description: ORF prefix list capability per neighbor. 'send' : Enables sending prefix list information to this neighbor. 'receive' : Enables receiving prefix list information from this neighbor. 'send' : Enables sending and receiving prefix list information for this neighbor.

ORF_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
ORF prefix list configuration for this neighbor.

in.description: The inbound prefix list that will be advertised to this neighbor. This will be used by the neighbor to filter the prefixes advertised to this router.

ORF_received_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
ORF prefix list received from this BGP neighbor.

in.description: Inbound prefix list information received from this neighbor. This will be used by the router to filter the prefixes advertised to this neighbor.

activate.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is activated in the address families.

ipv4-unicast.description: Activate neighbor in the IPv4 unicast address-family.

ipv6-unicast.description: Activate neighbor in the IPv6 unicast address-family.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Activate neighbor in the L2VPN EVPN address-family.

vpnv4-unicast.description: Activate neighbor in the VPNv4 unicast address-family.

add_paths.description: Configure BGP neighbor to advertise and receive additional paths : 'send': only ADD-PATH send capability will be advertised 'recv': only ADD-PATH receive capability will be advertised 'both': both ADD-PATH send and receive capabilities will be advertised 'disable': no ADD-PATH capability will be advertised

ipv4-unicast.description: Specifies whether this neighbor should advertise 'send' and/or 'receive' capability for additional path information corresponding to IPv4 prefixes.

ipv6-unicast.description: Specifies whether this neighbor should advertise 'send' and/or 'receive' capability for additional path information corresponding to IPv6 prefixes.

add_paths_adv_best_n.description: Configure the number of BGP paths to advertise to a BGP Peer.

ipv4-unicast.description: Specifies the number of BGP paths this neighbor can advertise for IPv4 prefixes.

ipv6-unicast.description: Specifies the number of BGP paths this neighbor can advertise for IPv6 prefixes.

advertisement_interval.description: Minimum interval between sending BGP routing updates. EBGP: default is 30 seconds. IBGP: default is 5 seconds.

ipv4-unicast.description: Minimum interval between sending BGP IPv4 unicast routing updates.

ipv6-unicast.description: Minimum interval between sending BGP IPv6 unicast routing updates.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_in_requ.description: Indicates the number of times soft clear was requested for inbound routing policy updates. When this value is greater than bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_in_performed, then soft clear is still pending.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_out_req.description: Indicates the number of times soft clear was requested for outbound routing policy updates. When this value is greater than bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_out_performed, then soft clear is still pending.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_in_perf.description: Indicates the number of times soft clear is performed for inbound routing policy updates.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_in_requ.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is now available at, [BGP_Neighbor](BGP_Neighbor.af_clear_counters_requested).

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_out_per.description: Indicates the number of times soft clear is performed for outbound routing policy updates.

allow_as_in.description: Number of times instance of local AS is allowed to be in the AS_PATH. If not configured, packets with AS_PATH containing local AS will be rejected.

ipv4-unicast.description: Number of times instance of local AS is allowed to be in the AS_PATH of IPv4 unicast enabled peers. If not configured, packets with AS_PATH containing local AS will be rejected.

ipv6-unicast.description: Number of times instance of local AS is allowed to be in the AS_PATH of IPv6 unicast enabled peers. If not configured, packets with AS_PATH containing local AS will be rejected.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Number of times instance of local AS is allowed to be in the AS_PATH of L2VPN EVPN enabled peers. If not configured, packets with AS_PATH containing local AS will be rejected.

ao_keychain.description:
Reference Resource: [Keychain](#/Keychain)
Reference to the keychain that is used to establish a TCP-AO enabled BGP session. TCP-AO will not take effect for the neighbor if keychain is not configured.

accept_ao_mismatch.description: This flag indicates whether the receiver should accept  segments for which the MAC in the incoming TCP AO does  not match the MAC generated on the receiver. if neighbor is not configured with the keychain  this option will not take effect.

include_tcp_options.description: This flag indicates whether TCP options other than TCP AO  will be included in calculating the packet MAC. if neighbor is not configured with the keychain  this option will not take effect.

AS Path filters for the session.

in.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_ASPath_Filter](#/BGP_ASPath_Filter)

out.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_ASPath_Filter](#/BGP_ASPath_Filter)
AS Path filter associated with the outbound routes.

bfd_enable.description: Enables BFD session to the specific neighbor.

bgp_peer_group.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Neighbor](#/BGP_Neighbor)

default_originate.description: Originate default route to the neighbor.

ipv4-unicast.description: Originate default route to the IPv4 unicast enabled neighbor.

ipv6-unicast.description: Originate default route to the IPv6 unicast enabled neighbor.

default_originate_route_map.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map](#/Route_Map)
Route-map that specifies the criteria for default origination.

ipv4-unicast.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map](#/Route_Map)
Route-map that specifies the criteria for default origination of IPv4 unicast routes

ipv6-unicast.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map](#/Route_Map)
Route-map that specifies the criteria for default origination of IPv6 unicast routes

description.description: Free form description of the neighbor.

dynamic_peer_count.description: The number of neighbors established for this dynamic peer group.

ebgp_hop_count.description: Maximum Hop Count for the EBGP Session. If 'ttl_security_hops' is configured, then 'ebgp_hop_count' is ignored.

fall_over.description: Fall-over the BGP session when route to this peer fails.

gshut.description: Specified parameters of the graceful shutdown to be applied on the neighbor.

local_pref.description: Local preference to use when neighbor advertises the routes with gshut community string.

timer.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for BGP convergence.

gshut_status.description: State in which the graceful shutdown process is in. 'initiated': graceful shutdown has been started for the neighbor. 'completed': graceful shutdown has been completed for the neighbor. Empty if graceful shutdown had never been initiated or if the new connection is established.

ignore_leading_as.description: Accept the routes form peer even if it doesn't has their own AS in the AS path

ipv4-unicast.description: Allow inbound soft reconfiguration for IPv4 unicast address-family.

ipv6-unicast.description: Allow inbound soft reconfiguration for IPv6 unicast address-family.

invalid_attributes.description: Specifies the action to take for invalid attributes.

accept_route.description: Configuring this will enable BGP to accept routes received with invalid attributes. If disabled, the BGP session may flap upon receiving routes with invalid attributes.

ip_or_ifname_or_group_name.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Neighbor](#/BGP_Neighbor)
BGP neighbors keyed by IP/IFNAME or neighbor groups keyed by any string name.

is_peer_group.description: Identifies specific BGP neighbor or BGP peer group 'true':    Entry is part of a peer-group and holds common            configuration 'false':   Entry is a neighbor

last_shutdown_time.description: The time (in seconds from epoch), when the connection was last shut down since the last boot.

listen_as_range.description: AS range for dynamic BGP neighbors. Example 100,65001-65010.

listen_ip_range.description: BGP dynamic neighbors are configured as ranges of remote addresses with associated peer groups. IPv4 or IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 192.168.0.0/16 IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 2001:0DB8:0000:000b::/64

listen_limit.description: The maximum number of dynamic BGP peers allowed for the listen range. This column value can be empty, indicates that unlimited number of dynamic BGP peers are accepted.

local_as.description: ASN to be used as a local ASN for this neighbor.

local_as_mode.description: 'no-prepend-replace-as-dual-as:'    The session can be established using either primary-as or alternate local-as.    Selected-as is not prepended to the inbound AS_PATH list,    but prepended to outbound AS_PATH list. 'no-prepend-replace-as':    The session is established via alternate local-as.    Both the alternate-as and primary-as are not prepended to the inbound AS_PATH list,    but alternate local-as is prepended to the outbound AS_PATH list. 'no-prepend':    The session is established via alternate local-as.    Both the alternate-as and primary-as are not prepended to the inbound AS_PATH list,    but prepended to the outbound AS_PATH list. 'none':    The session is established via alternate local-as.    Both the alternate-as and primary-as are prepended    to both the inbound and the outbound AS_PATH list.

local_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Loopback interface to be used as the source of the connection

max_prefix_options.description: Control maximum number of prefixes on the BGP session and behavior when the limit is approached

maximum_prefix_limit.description: Maximum number of prefixes that can be accepted on a BGP peer session.

restart.description: Number of seconds to wait after maximum prefix limit was reached to restart the session

threshold.description: Percentage of the maximum-prefixes at which to generate a warning message.

warning_disable.description: Controls the warning message logging upon reaching the maximum prefix for the neighbor. If set to true, no warning will be generated when maximum prefix limit is reached and BGP session with the neighbor will be terminated. If set to false, a warning message will be logged when maximum prefix limit is reached.

nbr_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
This is the unnumbered interface for the BGP peer.

negotiated_add_paths.description: The BGP additional path capability negotiated with this peer for this AFI/SAFI : 'disable : Disable sending and receiving additional BGP paths 'send'   : Send but do not receive additional BGP paths 'recv'   : Receive but do not send additional BGP paths 'both'   : Send and receive additional BGP paths

ipv4-unicast.description: Specifies negotiated additional paths capability for IPv4 prefixes corresponding to this neighbor.

ipv6-unicast.description: Specifies negotiated additional paths capability for IPv6 prefixes corresponding to this neighbor.

next_hop_self.description: Specifies whether the next hop attribute should be changed to router's own IP address.

ipv4-unicast.description: Specifies whether the next hop attribute should be changed for IPv4 unicast enabled peers to router's own IP address.

ipv6-unicast.description: Specifies whether the next hop attribute should be changed for IPv6 unicast enabled peers to router's own IP address.

next_hop_unchanged.description: Specifies whether the next hop attribute should be preserved when forwarding routes to eBGP peer.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Specifies whether the next hop attribute should be preserved when forwarding routes to eBGP peer in L2VPN EVPN address-family.

origin.description: Indicates whether the neighbor information has been received from the peer or locally configured.

passive.description: Identifies if 'open' messages should be sent to a neighbor 'true':    Do not send 'open' messages 'false':   Do send 'open' messages

password.description: Password to be used with the neighbor.

peer_rtrid.description: The BGP Identifier of the peer. Empty, unless bgpPeerStatusState is either 'openconfirm' or 'established'.

prefix_lists.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Prefix lists for the session.

in.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Prefix list associated with the inbound routes.

out.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Prefix list associated with the outbound routes.

received_remote_as.description: Remote_AS information advertised by this neighbor.

remote_as.description: Peer ASN. EBGP: must be different from the local ASN or BGP router ASN. IBGP: must be identical to either the local ASN or BGP router ASN.

remove_private_as.description: Specifies whether private AS should be removed.

replace_rt_asn.description: Specifies whether to replace the ASN portion of the route target  extended-community in the BGP update message with the local AS number.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Specifies whether to replace the ASN portion of the route-target  extended-community in the BGP update message with the local AS number.

route_maps.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map](#/Route_Map)
Route maps for the session.

in.description: Route map associated with inbound routes.

out.description: Route map associated with the outbound routes.

route_reflector_client.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is a route reflector client.

ipv4-unicast.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is a route reflector client in the IPv4 unicast address-family.

ipv6-unicast.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is a route reflector client in the IPv6 unicast address-family.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is a route reflector client in the L2VPN EVPN address-family.

vpnv4-unicast.description: Specifies whether the neighbor is a route reflector client in the VPNv4 address-family.

sel_local_port.description: Local port used by the transport connection.

sel_remote_port.description: Remote port used by the transport connection.

send_community.description: Community strings to be advertised along with the routes to the peer: 'both':      both Standard community and Extended community 'extended':  only Extended community 'standard':  only Standard community 'none':      no community will be advertised

ipv4-unicast.description: Community strings to be advertised along with the routes to the IPv4 unicast enabled peer.

ipv6-unicast.description: Community strings to be advertised along with the routes to the IPv6 unicast enabled peer.

l2vpn-evpn.description: Community strings to be advertised along with the routes to the L2VPN EVPN enabled peer.

vpnv4-unicast.description: Community strings to be advertised along with the routes to the VPNv4 unicast enabled peer.

shutdown.description: Shuts down neighbor session without removing configuration

slow_peer.description: Set to true to indicate that this neighbor is a slow peer. Slow peers that have same outbound policy are placed in a separate update-group.

bgp_peer_dropped_count.description: Number of times peers have been dropped from the established state.

bgp_peer_dynamic_cap_in_count.description: Number of times a dynamic cap message has been received.

bgp_peer_dynamic_cap_out_count.description: Number of times a dynamic cap message has been sent.

bgp_peer_established_count.description: Number of times peers have been established.

bgp_peer_keepalive_in_count.description: Number of times a keepalive message has been received.

bgp_peer_keepalive_out_count.description: Number of times a keepalive message has been sent.

bgp_peer_notify_in_count.description: Number of times a notify message has been received.

bgp_peer_notify_out_count.description: Number of times a notify message has been sent.

bgp_peer_open_in_count.description: Number of times an open message has been received.

bgp_peer_open_out_count.description: Number of times an open message has been sent.

bgp_peer_readtime.description: Epoch time when the last update or keepalive message has been received.

bgp_peer_refresh_in_count.description: Number of times a refresh message has been received.

bgp_peer_refresh_out_count.description: Number of times a refresh message has been sent.

bgp_peer_resettime.description: Epoch time of the last peer reset.

bgp_peer_update_in_count.description: Number of times an update message has been received.

bgp_peer_update_out_count.description: Number of times an update message has been sent.

bgp_peer_uptime.description: Number of seconds since peer transitions into the established state, or since the last route update was received.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_hard_reset_p.description: Indicates the number of times hard reset is performed for the peer.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_hard_reset_r.description: Indicates the number of times hard reset was requested for the peer. When this value is greater than bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_hard_reset_performed, then hard reset is still pending.

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_out_per.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is now available at, [BGP_Neighbor](BGP_Neighbor.af_status).

bgp_num_clear_counters_peer_soft_out_req.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is now available at, [BGP_Neighbor](BGP_Neighbor.af_clear_counters_requested).

bgp_rcvd_err_code.description: Error notification that was received on BGP connection termination.

bgp_rcvd_err_sub_code.description: Sub error notification that was received on BGP connection termination.

bgp_sent_err_code.description: Error notification that was sent on BGP connection termination.

bgp_sent_err_sub_code.description: Sub error notification that was sent on BGP connection termination.

tcp_port_number.description: Local TCP port to be used for the BGP session.

ttl_security_hops.description: Maximum allowed hops to a neighbor. This, when configured, takes precedence over 'ebgp_hop_count'.

update_group.description: Update-group that this peer is a member of.

update_source.description: Source IP address for the neighbor session.

weight.description: This is the weight for routes from this neighbor.
